pr.title: docs(fast-dev-os): install operational doctrine layer (authority refresh)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Installs `docs/03-reference/fast-dev-os/` as the operational doctrine layer that implements (does NOT override) the existing governance authority refresh at `docs/03-reference/governance/codex-authority-refresh.md`.
- Adds 6 operational ledgers (THREAD00 current operating, UNKNOWN/CONFLICTING/STALE register, PR snapshot, PACKET snapshot, PROOF snapshot) plus PROJECT_CONSTITUTION, README, and evidence-notes.
- Registers discoverability via single-line additions to `docs/INDEX.md` and `docs/docs_index.yaml`.
- Snapshot ledgers carry explicit `snapshot:` metadata (taken_at, repo_head, refresh_policy) to prevent stale-data-as-truth confusion.

## Scope
Docs/governance, doc-nav, task packet, and proof only. No runtime, service, test, compose, dependency, provider, or live extraction changes.

## Boundary discipline
- Every fast-dev-os doc includes a "Relationship to governance" section pointing back to `docs/03-reference/governance/codex-authority-refresh.md`.
- AGENTS.md §10 known dangers are carried forward as UNRESOLVED in UNKNOWN_CONFLICTING_STALE.md — not silently smoothed.
- chat-context-v2 corpus at `/Users/hue/Downloads/dopemux-chat-context-v2/` cited as advisory evidence only; provenance in evidence-notes.md.

## Validation
Include exact command outputs and exit codes for: jsonschema, docs_validator, docs_frontmatter_guard, grep for "Relationship to governance" and "snapshot:", git diff --check.

## NOT_RUN
- Live provider calls
- Live extraction
- Docker startup
- Runtime service health checks
- docs/00-MASTER-INDEX.md update (intrusive; deferred to a future TP)

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- RISK-SCHEMA: dopetask-canonical-spec.json execution.agent enum lacks claude_code; "codex" used for schema compliance.
- RISK-SNAPSHOT-STALENESS: PR/PACKET/PROOF ledgers go stale on next merge; mitigated by explicit snapshot metadata; generator-script enhancement deferred.
- RISK-EXTERNAL-EVIDENCE: chat-context-v2 corpus is outside repo; cited as advisory only.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, current branch/base, clean status, required authority files, and external evidence base availability.
commands: test -d /Users/hue/Downloads/dopemux-chat-context-v2 || echo 'chat-context-v2 corpus absent; evidence-notes will mark as UNAVAILABLE'
validation: Base branch must be main or branch created from main.
Required authority files must be present.
External chat-context-v2 evidence base availability must be recorded (PRESENT or UNAVAILABLE) for evidence-notes.

steps.task: Create this task packet JSON at the generated task-packet path; validate against dopetask-canonical-spec.json.
Author docs/03-reference/fast-dev-os/project-constitution.md and README.md as the doctrine entry-point.
requirements: PROJECT_CONSTITUTION.md defines: mission, scope, non-goals, vocabulary, boundaries vs the existing governance layer.
README.md is the discoverability landing page linking each ledger.
Every doc includes a "Relationship to governance" section pointing to docs/03-reference/governance/codex-authority-refresh.md.
Frontmatter follows Diataxis convention with id/title/type/owner/date/last_review/next_review/prelude fields.

steps.task: Author the four snapshot ledger files: THREAD00_CURRENT_OPERATING_LEDGER.md, PR_LEDGER.md, PACKET_LEDGER.md, PROOF_LEDGER.md.
requirements: Each contains an explicit `snapshot:` metadata block with taken_at, repo_head, origin_main_head, ledger_class=snapshot, refresh_policy=manual-per-session, next_review_trigger.
THREAD00 contains current branch, PR queue summary, active TP, recent merges, open blockers.
PR_LEDGER snapshot includes all open PRs from `gh pr list --state open` at snapshot time.
PACKET_LEDGER derives from task-packets/INDEX.md + task-packets/ inventory.
PROOF_LEDGER indexes proof/**/PROOF.json with verdict and commit SHA columns.
Each doc includes a "Relationship to governance" section.
UNKNOWN_CONFLICTING_STALE.md carries forward AGENTS.md §10 known dangers as UNRESOLVED.
UNKNOWN_CONFLICTING_STALE.md cites the chat-context-v2 corpus CROSS_PACKET_CONFLICTS.md and RECONCILED_MASTER_LEDGER.md as advisory evidence sources.
evidence-notes.md documents chat-context-v2 provenance (root path, retrieval date, selection criteria, why citations are external).

steps.task: Register discoverability: add a single line to docs/INDEX.md under Canonical Indexes and Lists, and a fast-dev-os key to docs/docs_index.yaml.
Create proof JSON with exact commands, exit codes, changed files, NOT_RUN items, residual risks, and UNKNOWNs.
Run final docs/proof validation, inspect diff scope, codereview, precommit, commit, push, and open PR.
validation: Changed files must be within commit.allowlist (13 paths: 8 fast-dev-os docs + 2 doc-nav files + TP JSON + PROOF JSON + .gitignore negation for proof/fast-dev-os/).
